hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.sable) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in */corpus/must-fail/*|*/corpus/test-fails/*|*/corpus/tests/*|*/corpus/svm-diff/*) exit 0;; esac; bin="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/compiler/target/debug/sable"; [ -x "$bin" ] || exit 0; out=$("$bin" check "$f" 2>&1) && exit 0; { echo "sable check failed for $f:"; echo "$out"; } >&2; exit 2
